resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly up1/down4, default Kaiser5 window; same chain for source and synthetic controls
phase_model: Interpolate existing per-note F0 frames; hold nearest endpoint outside .44..84. Integrate on48k grid with trapezoid, subsample phase to12k. No new pitch estimator.
carrier_offset_scope: Add same constant Hz to each tracked fundamental before harmonic multiplication; explicit sensitivity, not an identified bound on source pitch error.
local_estimator: One joint real LS per frame: cos/sin of all36 tracked harmonics +DC +scaled local time slope. Multiply data and design by Hann (Hann-squared objective). Normalize every design column by its L2 norm, solve via SVD rcond1e-12; never merge/drop colliding carriers adaptively.
conditioning: target cos/sin VIF from normalized Gram pseudoinverse
target estimator row L2 sensitivity to additive waveform noise
weighted residual RMS, source and every control

ratio_fit.model: All81 values jointly regressed against [1,x,x*x,sin(omega*(t-136.96)),cos(omega*(t-136.96))]; x=(t-137.04)/.16. Never detrend y alone.
ratio_fit.interpretation: Descriptive approximately2.134cycle projection; no independent-sample significance test.

source_weakness: Record all81 complex target amplitudes/powers, old frozen per-partial power thresholds and nearest original160ms mask flag. Local power=A²/2 is a sinusoidal coefficient proxy, not identical to old band integration. No row is removed; weak target frames can prevent interpretation.

synthetic.common_AM: 1-m*cos(2pi*fixed_rate*(t_context-.56)+phi); m=.7109245361481505, phi=-.4848223278487288, inherited prior source-only fit; no rate/phase/depth re-fit
nulls_per_phase: same static color with common AM
same common AM with per-note smooth exp(-[1.2,2,3]*(t-.44)) envelope after.44; ratios unchanged
same common AM plus fixed seeded Gaussian noise RMS1e-4 at48k
positive_controls_per_phase: C4 H3 and H4 each multiply10**(3*sin(omega*(t-136.96))/20), with common AM
same3dB cosine modulation, with common AM
synthetic.positive_purpose: Known ratio modulation checks bias, phase and smoothing; these are not physical filter models.

static_color_controls.per_note_cutoff: middle_C_cutoff*2**((note-60)/12), constant during entire signal; source-tracked pitch continues moving
static_color_controls.model: Per-voice fixed analog2pole HP then LP, prewarped bilinear SOS at48k, zero initial state atcontext0 (first analysis begins.44s later).
static_color_controls.purpose: Illustrative36member fixed-color/FM/AM null family. It is not an exhaustive bound on all static filters or a Ceres calibration.

interpretation_gates.geometry: Full rank74, scaled condition<=1e6, target VIF<=10 for allnominal frames; otherwise estimator inconclusive.
interpretation_gates.weakness: Any target weak frame is retained and prevents a clean target-level coloration conclusion.
interpretation_gates.common_AM_recovery: Across phase variants, peak fixed-rate ratio component of each common-AM null <=.5dB; known positives each have raw recovered3dB-component gain.5..1.5 and phase error<=20degrees. Failure means estimator inconclusive, never relaxed.
interpretation_gates.coloration_candidate: For both predeclared targets and all3windows atnominal following, source fixed-rate amplitude must exceed max(1dB,2*maximum common-AM/noise null amplitude,2*maximum static-color null amplitude). Source phase spread across windows<=30degrees, and source amplitude after division by matched positive-control RMS gain has max/min<=1.5.
interpretation_gates.carrier_sensitivity: Report±2Hz results and whether qualitative conclusion changes; do not claim those cases bound unknown actual F0 error.
interpretation_gates.negative_result: No detection does not exclude modulation; filters can act approximately as commongain over observed partials.
interpretation_gates.positive_result: At most stable ratio modulation beyond the tested null family; does not identify LPvsHP, VCFvsrecording coloration, ringvsVCA, or physicalcontrol settings.

limitations: Only about2modulationcycles and overlappingwindows; no IID p-values.
Ideal same-note ratios cannot separate HP fromLP cutoffmotion: HP/LP differ by a fixed harmonicfactor atmatched fc,Q.
PhysicalSUB-to-VCF/VCA relative sign is underseparateaudit; this diagnostic assumes no nativephase sign.

amendment.reason: Parent review requested resonant static controls at2/3/4 times existing early-median C4 F0 before any estimates; no other method/threshold change.

source_channel_policy: Arithmetic mean of the two retained float32 channels after conversion to float64, matching the existing source benchmark. No channel selection or gain fit.

input_shape_correction.reason: First implementation stopped before estimates on its incorrect mono assertion. Retained WAV is stereo; declare established benchmark downmix explicitly.
